The company’s manufacturing facilities are located at [[Nandesari]] and [[Dahej]] in [[Gujarat]], [[Roha]] and Taloja in [[Maharashtra]] and [[Hyderabad]] in [[Telangana]].{{Cite news|title=Deepak Nitrite Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/deepak-nitrite-136/information/company-history|url-status=live|access-date=2021-03-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210301182931/https://www.business-standard.com/company/deepak-nitrite-136/information/company-history|archive-date=2021-03-01}} Deepak Nitrite produces a spectrum of chemicals, including [[Agrochemical|agrochemicals]], [[Colourant|colourants]], [[rubber]], [[Medication|pharmaceuticals]], [[Speciality chemicals|speciality]] and [[Fine chemical|fine chemicals]].{{Cite web|title=Deepak Nitrite: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Deepak Nitrite - NDTV|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/deepak-nitrite-ltd_deepakntr/reports|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190827011402/https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/deepak-nitrite-ltd_deepakntr/reports|archive-date=2019-08-27|access-date=2021-03-06|website=www.ndtv.com|language=en}} Deepak Mehta is the [[Chairperson|chairman]] of the company and his son Maulik Mehta is the [[chief executive officer]].{{Cite web|title=Deepak Mehta|url=https://www.forbes.com/profile/deepak-mehta/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210427152124/https://www.forbes.com/profile/deepak-mehta/?sh=7ce08f047e05|archive-date=2021-04-27|access-date=2021-04-27|website=Forbes|language=en}} == History == The founder of the company Chimanlal Khimchand Mehta (father of Deepak Mehta) was the known chemical trader in [[Jain]] family of Gujarat. The company was incorporated in March 1970.{{Cite web|title=Deepak Nitrite|url=https://www.forbes.com/companies/deepak-nitrite/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210427152031/https://www.forbes.com/companies/deepak-nitrite/?sh=748443e3dd6e|archive-date=2021-04-27|access-date=2021-04-27|website=Forbes|language=en}} [[Sodium nitrite]] and nitrate plants were commissioned at [[Nandesari|Nadesari]], [[Vadodara]], [[Gujarat]] and production started in 1972. The plant produces chemicals like [[sodium nitrite]], [[sodium nitrate]] and other allied chemicals, dyes, hexamethylene tetramine and dyes intermediates.{{Cite web|title=Deepak Nitrite History {{!}} Deepak Nitrite Information - The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/deepak-nitrite-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13838.cms|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210420140940/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/deepak-nitrite-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13838.cms|archive-date=2021-04-20|access-date=2021-04-20|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com}} The company held its [[Initial public offering]] (IPO) in 1971. The IPO oversubscribed by 20 times. extract: Deepak Nitrite Ltd. is an Indian chemical manufacturing company. The company’s manufacturing facilities are located at Nandesari and Dahej in Gujarat, Roha and Taloja in Maharashtra and Hyderabad in Telangana. Deepak Nitrite produces a spectrum of chemicals, including agrochemicals, colourants, rubber, pharmaceuticals, speciality and fine chemicals. Deepak Mehta is the chairman of the company and his son Maulik Mehta is the chief executive officer.
